scopeReview: CED Topic 1.5 LIM-1.D: finite-limit sum/difference, product/power, quotient and composition properties with their hypotheses; continuous polynomial/rational/root substitution. Zero denominator cases are treated by laws/counterexamples without L’Hospital’s rule or an out-of-scope differentiation procedure.
varietyReview: Seven independent numerical expression checks plus four hypothesis/counterexample reasoning items. Includes a signed linear combination, square quotient, polynomial, fractional rational value, principal root/domain, continuous outer composition, indeterminate quotient, reciprocal, reconstructed limit, nonzero-over-zero contradiction and missing outer continuity. Basic, standard and multistep cases are balanced; alternatives encode different errors.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
